fields.name: prompt
fields.label: Prompt
fields.placeholder: the courier pushes off and rolls forward through the lantern glow; rain hisses on the stall awnings, a vendor calls out
fields.tooltip: Verb-first motion + the sounds. For keyframes the image already sets the scene — prompt what CHANGES.

fields.name: image
fields.label: First frame (keyframe lanes)
fields.tooltip: Absolute path to the PNG the video must start on (h3-keyframe). Optional for h3/h3-timeline.

fields.name: seed
fields.label: Seed
fields.tooltip: Same seed across re-rolls = same world texture

fields.name: steps
fields.label: Steps
fields.tooltip: 12 for draft; 30 standard; 10 with the turbo LoRA

fields.name: sharpen_enabled
fields.label: FSR Sharpening
fields.tooltip: Apply AMD FidelityFX RCAS sharpening to the final output. Strength 0.3 looks natural.

fields.name: sharpen_strength
fields.label: Sharpen Strength
fields.tooltip: RCAS sharpening intensity. 0.3 = natural; 0.5 = crisp; 0.0 = off.

fields.name: interpolate_enabled
fields.label: FILM Interpolation
fields.tooltip: Apply FILM (Feature-aware Interpolation for Large Motion) frame interpolation to double the frame rate. Doubles render time.

fields.name: shift_video
fields.label: Video Shift
fields.tooltip: Timestep shift for video attention. Higher = more coherent motion.

fields.name: shift_audio
fields.label: Audio Shift
fields.tooltip: Timestep shift for audio attention. Lower = more detailed sound.

Recipe.tooltip: One-click recipes — patch-only rows that stamp picks onto the draft; Default stamps nothing.

variants.label: Default
variants.hint: The family default — no extra stamps; a fresh card lands here.

enhance_prompts.prompt: structure: [subject, motion, camera, environment, sound]; rules:; - motion is the verb chain, not a pose: name what CHANGES across the window; - one camera move per shot (push in, truck left, locked off) — never two; - carry the subject's identity words into every shot that shows them; - end each shot prompt with its soundscape in one clause (room tone, foley, music); - a shot that cannot say its motion in one sentence is two shots
